r0.why: Multiplicative, Mobius 1832, inversion formula, Rota 1960s combinatorics generalizations all in [1]-[3].

r1.why: Coprime multiplicativity [17]; leads to inversion formula and main reason for relevance [18].

r2.why: 1*mu=epsilon [23], roots-of-unity proof [24], first-principles proof with n=1, bijection, odd/even subsets [25]-[28].

r3.why: Gauss characterization and congruence mod p [5],[6]; sum of primitive n-th roots of unity is mu(n) [20].

r4.why: Mean value zero and equivalence to prime number theorem in [33],[34].

r5.why: Primon gas, log(p), log(n) multiparticle, bosons/fermions, (-1)^F = mu, zeta partition function all in cited [8]-[15].

r6.why: Incidence algebra of locally finite poset, its Mobius function, classical case via divisibility in [40]-[42].
